# Resource Optimizer

> Frees disk space on macOS and Linux without losing anything you need. Measures read-only, ranks what fills the disk with a plain "need it?" answer, and hands you one command per group to run yourself. Never deletes on its own. Also eases RAM and CPU load. Freed <!--fact:freed_pct-->21%<!--/fact--> of a real Mac mini disk (<!--fact:freed_gb-->103.8 GB<!--/fact-->).

## Install

- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add maumoya/resource-optimizer` then `/plugin install resource-optimizer@resource-optimizer`
- Any agent: `npx skills add maumoya/resource-optimizer`

- GitHub Action: `uses: maumoya/resource-optimizer@v0.3.0` with `min-free-percent`, read-only runner disk check

## Files

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/maumoya/resource-optimizer/blob/main/skills/resource-optimizer/SKILL.md): the skill
- [README.md](https://github.com/maumoya/resource-optimizer/blob/main/README.md): what it does and how to install it
